answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves weight in the EigenTrust matrix. A freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted, reciprocal endorsements; collusive clusters cannot bootstrap influence or pass consensus. Even an oasis of fabricated praise in an orchard of aliases remains at the trust nadir until independently validated over time.
